instructions.text: Start a post opens the post composer. Enter the intended post in its writing field; scheduling controls belong to this composer.

For an authorized scheduled post, use the clock control, enter the requested date and time, then Next. Inspect the displayed schedule before choosing Schedule. The device time zone affects the scheduled time.
View all scheduled posts is available from the scheduling dialog. After scheduling, open that list and inspect the matching post and schedule to verify the result.
Check the composer’s displayed author and audience before publishing or scheduling. A Chrome profile and a signed-in LinkedIn identity are separate pieces of evidence.
